payload.text: Golden-oracle gate (Black-76 commodity/forward reference): black76_undiscounted_price is a pure closed-form function of (cp, forward, strike, vol, t) using only libm math and the pure xerf_norm_cdf, with the t<=0 intrinsic-payoff branch. No writes, no I/O, deterministic — the QuantLib-pinned reference price the parity suite gates production engines against must be a pure function of its inputs.
